home.title: RentalOS — Rental Booking System for Car, Yacht & Villa Rentals

home.heroSub: Bookings, confirmations, and follow-ups — handled automatically so you can focus on the rental.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.description: Start free for 14 days. No credit card required.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: For self-serve plans, you can be live in under an hour. For Done-for-you setup, we deploy within 48 hours of receiving your business details.
faq.q2: What rental types does it support?
faq.a2: Car rental, yacht charter, villa rental, motorcycle rental, and any other time-based item rental. The platform is category-agnostic.
faq.q3: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a3: Yes. The Pro plan includes a custom domain setup. Starter and Growth plans can add a custom domain for €199 once.
faq.a4: Yes — all subscription plans include a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
